note: The crafts of the Unspooling/Lattice-Cities Reach (chaos_order axis). Wildcraft is the chaos-pole tradition, Latticework the order-pole. Learned by traveling the Reach or training with Churnfolk/Lattice-wrights. Higher tiers drift the wielder toward their pole. axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016 skill build-out.

abilities.name: Wildcraft
abilities.narrationHints: The art of the unplanned — riding luck, breaking patterns, making the improvised thing work because you refused to plan it.
abilities.description: The chaos-craft: improvisation as power, luck-riding, the unmaking of others' plans. The Churnfolk discipline of productive disorder.
abilities.notFor: Reliable repeatable results (that's Latticework's job); fine control; anything that needs to work the same way twice.

tree.name: The Lucky Break
tree.grants: Turn a chaotic moment to advantage; improvise a working solution from whatever's to hand; make one plan (yours or theirs) come apart usefully.
tree.cannot: You don't choose HOW it breaks, only that it does; luck spent runs thin.

tree.name: Riding the Churn
tree.grants: Thrive where others founder in disorder; read the grain of a chaotic situation and ride it; deny an enemy the predictability they rely on.
tree.cannot: Cannot impose an outcome, only surf toward a good one; the ordered and prepared can still beat you.

tree.name: The Unspooling
tree.grants: Unmake order at scale — a fortress's discipline, a system's certainty, a plan a season in the making, come apart; and out of the loosed chaos, seize the one opening that wouldn't have existed in order.
tree.cannot: What you unspool you cannot re-order; the wielder drifts chaos-hot; the Grand Lattice marks you as an enemy.

mechanic.note: T-II construct — but see `variance`. Churnfolk crafts want a WIDENED OUTCOME BAND, not a fixed magnitude: 'you don't choose HOW it breaks, only that it does.'

rankDeltas.delta: THRIVE where others founder — read the grain of a chaotic situation and RIDE it; DENY AN ENEMY THE PREDICTABILITY THEY RELY ON (a direct debuff to ordered opponents)
UNMAKE ORDER AT SCALE — a fortress's discipline, a system's certainty, a plan a season in the making, come apart; and out of the loosed chaos, something useful
rankDeltas.from: r3 grants — the explicit counter to lattice's latticework r3 'impose structure at scale'

intensity.conserve: a small improvisation — half the effect, and you keep control of what breaks
intensity.surge: double it; YOU DO NOT CHOOSE HOW IT BREAKS, and at this scale that matters

bounds.text: YOU DON'T CHOOSE HOW IT BREAKS, only that it does
luck spent runs thin
CANNOT IMPOSE AN OUTCOME, only surf toward a good one
the ordered and prepared resist it
WHAT YOU UNSPOOL YOU CANNOT RE-ORDER
the wielder DRIFTS CHAOS-HOT

abilities.plainly: A chase/fight/puzzle action that makes or animates something. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10 across a scope of 2, and lasts for about 2 hours Ranks: rank 2 deepens variance; rank 3 extends scope. Limit: you Don'T Choose How IT Breaks, only that it does.

abilities.name: Latticework
abilities.narrationHints: Structure imposed and possibility bound — a plan that holds, a prediction that lands, a binding that will not slip.
abilities.description: The order-craft: structure, prediction, law, the binding of possibility. The Lattice-Cities' discipline — order as power.
abilities.notFor: Improvisation or the genuinely novel (that's Wildcraft); anything that needs to breathe or grow; controlling people's hearts (only their structures).

tree.name: The Sure Plan
tree.grants: Build a plan that holds under pressure; predict a system's next move; impose enough order on chaos to act cleanly in it.
tree.cannot: Prediction fails on the truly chaotic; a plan is not a guarantee, only good odds.

tree.name: The Binding Frame
tree.grants: Bind a possibility down — make a thing reliably true, a route reliably safe, an agreement reliably kept; read a system deeply enough to break OR fortify it at the load-bearing point.
tree.cannot: Binding is brittle against Wildcraft; over-bound systems can't adapt and shatter when they must.

tree.name: The Grand Order
tree.grants: Impose structure at scale — a lawless place made orderly, a chaotic force predicted and countered, a possibility foreclosed by sheer structure. The Lattice's power in miniature.
tree.cannot: The wielder drifts order-hot — and order at full strength IS the foreclosure the framework names as the enemy; the Churn and the free places will not forgive it; perfect order is a cage even when it's yours.

mechanic.note: T-II construct. r1: build a plan that HOLDS UNDER PRESSURE; predict a system's next move

rankDeltas.delta: BIND A POSSIBILITY DOWN — make a thing reliably true, a route reliably safe, an agreement reliably kept; read a system deeply enough to break OR repair it
rankDeltas.from: r2 grants — reliability becomes the operative axis

rankDeltas.delta: impose structure AT SCALE — a lawless place made orderly, a chaotic force predicted and countered, A POSSIBILITY FORECLOSED BY SHEER STRUCTURE

intensity.conserve: a working plan — half the binding, and nothing calcifies
intensity.surge: double the structure; over-bound systems CANNOT ADAPT and shatter when they finally break

bounds.text: prediction fails on the TRULY CHAOTIC
a plan is not a guarantee, only good odds
binding is BRITTLE AGAINST WILDCRAFT
over-bound systems can't adapt and shatter
the wielder DRIFTS ORDER-HOT — and order at full strength IS the foreclosure the framework warns about

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/fight/social action that makes or animates something. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10 across a scope of 2, and lasts for about 4 hours Ranks: rank 2 deepens reliability; rank 3 extends scope. Limit: prediction fails on the Truly Chaotic.

abilities.name: Chaos-Sense
abilities.narrationHints: A feel for where a situation is about to come apart.
abilities.description: Sense instability, imminent disorder, the fault-line in a plan.
abilities.notFor: Predicting exactly how; ordered systems' inner logic.

tree.name: Chaos-Sense
tree.grants: Feel where and roughly when something will break down; find the loose thread.
tree.cannot: Feel, not detail; the truly stable reads quiet.

tree.name: The Coming Turbulence
tree.grants: Feel where a situation is about to come apart, and roughly how.
tree.cannot: You feel the break coming; you do not get to choose where you are standing when it does.

tree.name: The Break Before It Breaks
tree.grants: The failure announces itself to you before it happens — the bridge, the alliance, the plan.
tree.cannot: Knowing is not preventing, and the Churnfolk have made peace with that in a way others find infuriating.

mechanic.note: r1: feel WHERE and roughly WHEN something will break down; find the loose thread

rankDeltas.delta: feel where a SITUATION is about to come apart, and roughly HOW — from a thing to a situation, and the failure MODE
SPECIAL: the failure ANNOUNCES ITSELF to you before it happens — the bridge, the alliance, the plan. Unprompted warning is a different act from looking for the flaw.

intensity.conserve: a feel for the loose thread — half the warning, no cost
intensity.surge: double the reach: the failure comes to you, and you still do not get to choose where you are standing when it lands

bounds.text: FEEL, NOT DETAIL — the truly stable reads quiet
you feel the break coming; YOU DO NOT GET TO CHOOSE WHERE YOU ARE STANDING when it arrives

abilities.name: Order-Sense
abilities.narrationHints: The hidden structure of a thing laid bare to a reading eye.
abilities.description: Perceive the underlying order, rule, or pattern in a system.

tree.name: Order-Sense
tree.grants: See a system's structure, rules, and load-bearing points at a glance.
tree.cannot: Reads structure, not intent; pure chaos returns noise.

tree.name: The Pattern Beneath
tree.grants: Read the structure under a mess — the schedule behind a crowd, the rule behind a ritual.
tree.cannot: Some messes have no pattern. Reading one into them is how the Lattice makes its worst mistakes.

tree.name: The Whole Design
tree.grants: See the entire design a thing is part of — including the parts of it that are not present.
tree.cannot: Seeing the design does not give you standing to change it.

mechanic.note: r1: see a system's structure, rules, and load-bearing points AT A GLANCE

rankDeltas.delta: read the structure UNDER A MESS — the schedule behind a crowd, the rule behind a ritual
rankDeltas.from: r2 grants — from visible order to hidden order

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: see the ENTIRE DESIGN a thing is part of — INCLUDING THE PARTS THAT ARE NOT PRESENT. Inferring absent structure is a different act from reading present structure.

intensity.conserve: a glance — half the depth, and it costs nothing
intensity.surge: double the read: the whole design, and you will see patterns that are not there if you push it

bounds.text: reads STRUCTURE, not INTENT
pure chaos returns noise

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.narrationHints: One shove and the neat thing is a mess and you're through the gap.
abilities.description: Introduce sharp disorder — scatter a formation, foul a mechanism, open a gap in order.

tree.name: Scatter
tree.grants: Disrupt a formation, jam a device, break a pattern to make an opening.
tree.cannot: You don't pick how it scatters; brief.

tree.name: The Scattering
tree.grants: Scatter a formation, a plan, a crowd — the thing that was one thing becomes many and cannot re-form quickly. Each of them is weakened by it: alone, out of place, and fighting or working at a fraction of what they were worth in line.
tree.cannot: What you scatter you no longer control. Scattering a mob makes many small problems.

tree.name: Nothing Holds
tree.grants: Unmake the coherence of a thing entirely — an army, a contract, a certainty — and it does not come back together.
tree.cannot: The Churnfolk warn: you will not be able to put it back. Nobody will.

mechanic.note: T-II hobble, incapacitating rung. r1: disrupt a formation, jam a device, break a pattern to make an opening

rankDeltas.delta: scatter a formation, a plan, a CROWD — the thing that was one becomes MANY and cannot re-form quickly; EACH is weakened by it
SPECIAL: unmake the COHERENCE of a thing entirely — an army, a contract, a certainty — AND IT DOES NOT COME BACK TOGETHER. Permanence is the kind-change.

intensity.conserve: break one pattern — half the scatter, and it re-forms
intensity.surge: double it: what you scatter you NO LONGER CONTROL, and scattering a mob makes many small problems

bounds.text: YOU DON'T PICK HOW IT SCATTERS
brief at r1
WHAT YOU SCATTER YOU NO LONGER CONTROL — scattering a mob makes many small problems
THE CHURNFOLK WARN: YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO PUT IT BACK. NOBODY WILL.

abilities.name: Set in Order
abilities.narrationHints: A word, and the chaos falls into rank.
abilities.description: Impose quick order on a small chaotic scene — rally a panic, sort a mess, steady a wobble.

tree.name: Set in Order
tree.grants: Calm a panicking group, quickly organize a chaotic space, steady a failing structure briefly.
tree.cannot: Small scale; slips without maintenance.

tree.name: The Righted Thing
tree.grants: Set a thing into its proper order and it STAYS — a room, a ledger, a broken argument.
tree.cannot: Order imposed is not order accepted. What you right, someone may resent being righted.

tree.name: As It Should Be
tree.grants: Name a thing's true order and it takes it — the crooked wall stands straight, the failing plan coheres.
tree.cannot: The Lattice's great sin is believing it always knows what a thing SHOULD be.

mechanic.note: r1: calm a panicking group, organize a chaotic space, steady a failing structure BRIEFLY

rankDeltas.delta: set a thing into its proper order AND IT STAYS — a room, a ledger, a broken argument (from 'briefly' to persistent)

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: NAME a thing's true order AND IT TAKES IT — the crooked wall stands straight, the failing plan coheres. Declaring order into being is a different act from imposing it.

intensity.surge: double the ordering; what you right, someone may resent being righted

ORDER IMPOSED IS NOT ORDER ACCEPTED — what you right, someone may resent
THE LATTICE'S GREAT SIN IS BELIEVING IT ALWAYS KNOWS WHAT A THING SHOULD BE

abilities.plainly: A social/fight/survive action that strengthens someone. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10 across a scope of 1, and lasts for about 2 hours Ranks: rank 2 extends duration; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: order Imposed IS Not Order Accepted — what you right, someone may resent.

abilities.name: Tilt
abilities.narrationHints: The dice of the moment lean your way, just once, just enough.
abilities.description: Nudge chance in a chaotic moment — the lucky slip, the fumbled guard, the door that happens to be open.

tree.name: Tilt
tree.grants: Tilt an uncertain moment toward a good break for you.
tree.cannot: Only where chance is live; spends fast.

tree.name: The Long Tilt
tree.grants: Tilt the odds of a whole sequence, not one roll — the run of luck bends your way. Inside that run everything you attempt comes off better than your skill alone should manage — the throw lands, the grip holds, the word arrives right.
tree.cannot: Tilted odds are still odds. The Churn keeps its right to the improbable.

tree.name: The Loaded World
tree.grants: Around you, the unlikely simply happens — the gap opens, the guard turns, the coin lands.
tree.cannot: The world balances its books. Whatever you tilt toward you, something tilts away, and you will not see it coming.

mechanic.note: T-III bolster. r1: tilt an UNCERTAIN moment toward a good break

rankDeltas.delta: tilt the odds of a WHOLE SEQUENCE, not one roll — inside that run everything comes off better than it should
rankDeltas.from: r2 grants — one moment → a run

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: around you THE UNLIKELY SIMPLY HAPPENS — the gap opens, the guard turns, the coin lands

intensity.conserve: a nudge — half the tilt, and the books balance quietly

abilities.name: The Fixed Point
abilities.narrationHints: You become the one thing the chaos organizes around.
abilities.description: Make yourself or a thing the stable anchor in disorder — others orient to you, the storm bends around.
abilities.notFor: Stopping the chaos; moving while anchoring.

tree.name: The Fixed Point
tree.grants: Be the still, reliable point in a chaotic scene; let others rally to you.
tree.cannot: You must hold still; strong chaos still batters.

tree.name: The Anchor
tree.grants: Be the thing that does not move — a person, a promise, a position — while everything around you does.
tree.cannot: Being unmoved is not being unharmed. The Churn breaks around you, and around includes on.

tree.name: The Point That Does Not Move
tree.grants: You become the fixed point others navigate by; chaos itself organizes around your refusal to shift.
tree.cannot: A fixed point cannot also be a traveler. What you anchor, you are anchored to.

mechanic.note: T-III guard. r1: be the still, reliable point in a chaotic scene; LET OTHERS RALLY TO YOU

rankDeltas.delta: be THE THING THAT DOES NOT MOVE — a person, a promise, a position — while everything around you does
SPECIAL: you become THE FIXED POINT OTHERS NAVIGATE BY — chaos itself ORGANIZES AROUND your refusal to shift
rankDeltas.from: r3 grants — the world reorganising around you is a kind-change

intensity.surge: double the fixity; a fixed point CANNOT ALSO BE A TRAVELER

strong chaos still batters

abilities.name: The Riding Order
abilities.narrationHints: Unmake and re-make in one motion — collapse it, and catch the pieces as what you need.
abilities.description: The braid-craft: unmake a structure and re-bind its falling pieces into a new form mid-collapse.

tree.name: The Riding Order
tree.grants: Break a thing and reforge its pieces into what you need in the same motion.
tree.cannot: A heartbeat's window; miss it and you've only made chaos.

tree.name: The Long Riding
tree.grants: The window widens from a heartbeat to a breath, and the scale from a thing to a structure — ride the collapse of a wall, a wagon, a bridge, a formation, and set what is falling into the shape you need before it lands.
tree.cannot: A widened window is still a window. The larger the collapse the cruder the form that comes out of it. And what you ride, you own — a structure re-bound wrong comes down on you first, and the Riders consider that only fair.

mechanic.note: T-IV. r1: break a thing and REFORGE ITS PIECES INTO WHAT YOU NEED IN THE SAME MOTION — a heartbeat's window

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: the window widens from a HEARTBEAT to a BREATH, and the scale from a THING to a STRUCTURE — ride the collapse of a wall, a wagon, a bridge, a formation. Riding a collapse rather than causing one is the T-IV kind-change.

intensity.conserve: a small reforging — half the scale, and a miss only costs you the piece
intensity.surge: double the scale; THE LARGER THE COLLAPSE THE CRUDER THE FORM you can catch out of it

bounds.text: A HEARTBEAT'S WINDOW — miss it and YOU HAVE ONLY MADE CHAOS
a widened window is STILL a window
the larger the collapse, THE CRUDER THE FORM

abilities.plainly: A fight or puzzle action, and the only craft in the game with a timing window. You break something and reforge its falling pieces into a new shape in the same motion — but you must declare the new form before you break it, and you get one heartbeat to land it. Miss the window and you have simply destroyed the thing. Higher ranks widen the window and let you work on larger collapses, but the bigger the collapse the cruder the result: a shattered cart becomes a barricade, never a second cart.

abilities.name: The Long Odds
abilities.narrationHints: Every break falls your way at once — the impossible escape, the pursuit that always closes.
abilities.description: The chase capstone: in flight or pursuit, bend a whole cascade of chance — the gate that's open, the guard that looks away, the ledge that holds. The escape (or the catch) that shouldn't have been possible.
abilities.notFor: Guaranteed outcomes (it's improbable, not certain); stationary situations; use twice quickly.

tree.name: The Long Odds
tree.grants: Turn a whole chase — escape a closing net, or run down a fleeing foe — by riding a cascade of lucky breaks no one could plan. Everyone running with you is carried by it too: for the length of the chase they are faster and surer than they are, because nothing goes wrong for them.
tree.cannot: Spends enormously; the ordered and prepared can still corner you; fails hard if the luck runs out mid-flight.

mechanic.note: T-V capstone. r1: turn a WHOLE CHASE by riding a cascade of lucky breaks no one could plan

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: ride a CASCADE of improbabilities through an entire chase — escape a closing net, or run down a fleeing foe. The capstone is a KIND (bending a whole sequence of events) at enormous cost.
rankDeltas.from: r1 grants — single-rank capstone; the special IS the craft

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — the long odds are not a thing you take halfway; a hedged cascade is just ordinary luck.
intensity.surge: REFUSED — it already spends enormously; there is nothing above it to spend.

bounds.text: SPENDS ENORMOUSLY

abilities.name: Set to Rights
abilities.narrationHints: Not better. Correct. The thing as it was meant to be, rebuilt from first principles.

tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — restore not just function but the underlying conditions for continued function — the body that heals cleanly, the mechanism that runs without further adjustment; requires knowing what the INTENDED STATE was.

tree.name: Structural Repair
tree.grants: Restore not just function but the underlying conditions for continued function — the body that heals cleanly, the mechanism that runs without further adjustment.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 3 adds — return a thing fully to its intended state — a person to health, a plan to viability, a structure to integrity — through methodical, exhaustive work; requires knowing what the INTENDED STATE was.

tree.name: Full Restoration
tree.grants: Return a thing fully to its intended state — a person to health, a plan to viability, a structure to integrity — through methodical, exhaustive work.
tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; requires knowing what the INTENDED STATE was.

mechanic.note: T-II healing. r1: diagnose EXACTLY what's wrong and apply the precise intervention — NO GUESSING, NO WASTE. The +2 is the precision: lattice healing wastes nothing.

abilities.name: The Established Route

notFor: Forcing a passage that has no order to move through

tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — navigate any sufficiently structured system — a city's hierarchy, a fortress's regulations, a court's protocols — using its own rules to go where you need to go; requires a system that HAS rules.

tree.name: Seam-Walker

tree.cannot: Anything rank 3 adds — move through a system as if you designed it — through the parts only insiders know, at the speed the structure permits at its best, without a door that won't open for you; requires a system that HAS rules.

tree.name: The Inside Line
tree.grants: Move through a system as if you designed it — through the parts only insiders know, at the speed the structure permits at its best, without a door that won't open for you.
tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; requires a system that HAS rules; and it still costs what it costs: the route is LAWFUL, which means it is also LOGGED.

mechanic.note: EVASION, not armour — Erik's correction. Soak reduces damage AFTER a hit lands; evasion means the attack DOESN'T land. The craft's own prose says it: 'not blocking, not armoring, just not being where they land.' PROPOSED MECHANIC (fits the existing degree ladder exactly, no new resolution stage): evasion DEGRADES the attacker's degree by one step — crit_success→success, success→PARTIAL, partial→FAILURE. Then Erik's second half: on the PARTIAL that remains, the small soak applies — the graze. So a full hit becomes a graze, and the graze is blunted.

abilities.name: The Long Odds Come In
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing is aimed at them. The strap simply parts, the footing simply goes, the ember simply finds the oil, the horse simply decides. Any one of these was possible. You made all of them likely at once, and then stood back.
abilities.description: The Churnfolk's first offense: you do not attack, you spend the world's unlikeliness. Whatever could go wrong for them, does.
abilities.notFor: Choosing WHICH misfortune (you buy that something goes wrong, never what); a target with nothing around them — bare ground and no gear gives the Churn nothing to work with; repeating it (the odds you spent are spent); anything you need to happen on a schedule.

tree.name: The Turn of It
tree.grants: Spend the Churn against one target in a place with things in it. Something fails against them — gear, footing, an animal, a bystander's elbow, the weather. Real harm, entirely deniable.
tree.cannot: YOU DO NOT CHOOSE WHAT. The GM picks the misfortune from what is actually present. A target in a bare, empty place is nearly immune. It works ONCE cleanly; the second use in a scene is weaker and stranger.

tree.name: The Run of Bad
tree.grants: Spend it wider — a squad, a caravan, a line. Several small catastrophes at once, none of them traceable to you.
tree.cannot: ⚠ THE CHURN DOES NOT SORT: anyone else in the same area is struck ONE RUNG LOWER by the same run of luck. And nobody believes it was luck twice.

tree.name: The Long Odds
tree.grants: The genuinely unlikely thing. The keystone, the powder, the flood-gate, the one animal that could have ended this. It comes in. AND YOU CAN STAND OUTSIDE THE RUN NOW — you and anyone you name are exempt from the misfortune you spend.
tree.cannot: You still do not choose WHAT. The Churn takes what it takes, and the unlikely thing may cost a bridge, a building, or someone you needed alive — it is exempt from harming you, not from ruining your plans.
